The digestive tract includes the mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intesti
Digestion releases nutrients that give the body energy and help it stay strong and healthy
The circulatory system transports oxygen and nutrients throughout the body.
The heart and blood vessels are key parts of the circulatory system.
Blood carries oxygen and nutrients and helps remove wastes from the body.
The respiratory system takes in oxygen when inhaling.
The respiratory system releases carbon dioxide when exhaling.
The lungs are key organs for breathing.
Air contains oxygen and other gases, and oxygen is a basic need of living things.
Too little oxygen can cause suffocation.
